<div class="card-body">
'''Blaster''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ブラスター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費し、任意の戦士に配備する。1フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引き、キャラクターなら運命数＞能力値で、ビークルなら運命数＞回避値か装甲値で命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Blaster-C1G.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">머ソン44型ブラスター・ピストル。パワー・パックと高圧ブラスター・ガスを使い、起爆性の収束光を打ち出す。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blaster.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on any warrior. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny > ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny > maneuver or armor.

'''Lore:'''
A Merr-Sonn Model 44 blaster pistol. It uses a power pack and high-pressure blaster gas to fire explosive coherent light.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore prints 머ソン44型 and high-pressure blaster gas (高圧) rather than high-energy.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blaster]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
